concepts.name: Ufuk
concepts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: original symbol-only logo exploration for Veri_Ufku, a Linux desktop data exploration application. Exactly one centered mark on a genuinely transparent square canvas with generous margins. Elegant professional flat vector-like logo, simple bold geometry and strong recognizable silhouette at small app-icon sizes. Opaque solid fills, precise smooth clean edges. This is an exploration of DISTINCT NEW SHAPES, not a recoloring of a compass or four-node diamond. No typography, text, letters spelled out, captions, mockups, border, multiple marks, gradients, glow, shadows, 3D, texture, decorative speckles, checkerboard or translucent edge halos. Intended UI background #151722, but DO NOT paint any background. Concept: a restrained abstract horizon emblem, one bold semicircular rising sun with a single clean horizontal horizon cut across its lower third, and a short separate horizon stroke extending slightly beyond the disc. Suggest discovery and clarity rather than beach tourism. Warm orange #F6A35D only. Carefully balanced negative space; minimal circular geometry, no rays or landscape details.
